This is a placeholder reference page for interval-input transforms.

## Current Interval-Focused Transforms

Legacy transform system:

- `Group Intervals` (`DigitalIntervalSeries` -> `DigitalIntervalSeries`)
- `Boolean Operation` (`DigitalIntervalSeries` (+ optional second
  interval series) -> `DigitalIntervalSeries`)

TransformsV2 family (names in registry):

- `DigitalIntervalBoolean`
- `AnalogIntervalReduction`
- `EventIntervalReduction`
- `IntervalOverlapReduction`

## Notes

- The next version of this page will map each transform to UI names,
  parameter schemas, and output tensor structure where applicable.
